name: Lenny's Podcast
notes: Broad product/growth podcast. Filter tightly — only AI-dev-workflow episodes are in scope. High view count on an AI episode = strong signal the guest's ideas have mainstream traction.

name: Latent Space
notes: Highly relevant by default — most episodes are Tier 1 or 2. Still filter: research-only episodes (no practical workflow) are Tier 3.

name: How I AI (Claire Vo, Lenny's network)
notes: Practitioner workflow focus. Secondary signal after Lenny's main feed.

name: AI Engineer (aiengineer.com)
notes: Primary event source. Every event publishes all talks to YouTube. Check for new events each run and sweep full speaker list. Cross-reference speakers against people.json.

name: Simon Willison's Blog
notes: Simon is one of the highest-signal individual bloggers on practical LLM use. Every post is worth checking — he writes about tooling, security (prompt injection), TDD with AI, and tracks the field comprehensively. Check for new posts in the research window.

name: Matt Pocock (YouTube)
notes: Highest-signal Claude Code subscription practitioner on YouTube. Tutorials, skill walkthroughs, Sandcastle demos. Check for new uploads each run.

name: Hacker News
notes: Show HN posts with 50+ points are strong signal. Also check comment threads on high-point posts — practitioners often share concrete patterns in comments. Username → GitHub profile is the main discovery path.

name: Bluesky
notes: AI Engineer community is active here. Starter packs are a useful directory — check for new ones. Accounts posting 3+ substantive Claude Code workflow posts in the window are worth tracking.

name: Reddit
notes: r/ClaudeAI is the primary signal. Posts with 100+ upvotes about Claude Code workflows often surface practitioners not yet in mainstream AI content. Username → GitHub → real name is the discovery path.

name: GitHub Trending
notes: Check weekly trending for both TypeScript and Python. Star velocity (stars gained this week, not total) is the signal — a repo gaining 500 stars in a week is more relevant than one with 10k total but no recent momentum.

name: Twitter / X
notes: Less reliable than Bluesky for this community but still worth checking for viral workflow threads. Accounts with 50+ likes on a Claude Code workflow post and an active GitHub are worth ingesting.
